text:
alex: Heads-up — ran into an ambiguity during integration tests: requests sometimes carry both X-Org-ID and X-Project-ID from legacy clients. Which should we treat as authoritative for quota/telemetry/console rowing?

maria: oof. currently we prioritize Project if present, then Org. That was never formally documented tho.

tj: Can you paste the failing log? Curious what the payload looks like.

alex: here — snippet from proxy logs: 
```
{"headers": {"X-Org-ID": "org-42", "X-Project-ID": "proj-99", "Authorization": "APIKEY:sk_live_..."}, "route": "/v1/generate"}
```

sam: Are clients setting both intentionally? Might be double-binding during migrations.

maria: Yeah some mobile SDKs were patched to include org header for analytics, but they still send a project id for billing. We saw mismatch in attribution.

tj: For attribution we should probably prefer Project for billing, but Org for console breadcrumbing. That's two different answers.

alex: Exactly — that split is the pain. Right now telemetry uses whichever identity the auth service resolved first, so dashboards show inconsistent rows.

maria: Proposal: add deterministic "identity_resolution" policy: 1) If Authorization key maps to a single project, use that project (billing). 2) If auth key is org-scoped (no project), fall back to X-Project-ID header if present but mark as "unverified-project". 3) Always record X-Org-ID as org_tag but mark as secondary if it conflicts.

sam: How would that affect existing quota checks? We have quota enforcement in the routing layer that expects a single tenant id.

tj: We can keep enforcement as before but attach a resolution_reason enum to each request for downstream metrics. Enforcement will still pick the resolved billing_project.

alex: Would like an explicit flag to opt into the new resolution before rollout — console toggle per org?

maria: We can expose a console feature flag (beta: identity-resolution:v2) in the org admin settings. Default off for now.

sam: Important: if we do default-off, canary clients will look fine but we need sampling in telemetry to compare both behaviors. Add a sampling path that logs both old and new resolution for same request (no PII).

tj: Agreed. Logging both is cheap. We should also emit a metric: identity_resolution_mismatch{org,route}=1 when project_from_header != project_from_auth.

alex: UI question — ops want a single canonical column in the console usage table. If we show both, it'll confuse customers.

maria: Console UX idea: show "Resolved billing project" as primary column and an expand chevron to show "Observed headers" (org, raw project header, auth-mapped project). Helps audits.

sam: Also add a tooltip about "unverified" so support knows to ask for SDK version.

tj: For rollout plan: 1) implement in auth service with resolution_reason tags, 2) route-level sampling for dual-resolve logs, 3) backend metrics for mismatch rates, 4) console flag and UI changes, 5) enable for 5% orgs, ramp.

alex: timeline? we need this before next week's partner demo.

maria: MVP (server + metrics + sampling) in 3 days, console toggle + UI in 2 weeks. For the demo we can enable env flag for the partner org.

sam: Any security concerns? If we accept project header as fallback, could a malicious client spoof billing?

tj: Only if auth key isn't tied to a tenant. We must forbid fallback when Authorization key maps to another org. Fallback allowed only when auth key has no project binding. Add a strict check: if auth_project && auth_project != header_project -> ignore header and set mismatch metric.

maria: I'll document the policy and add a note in the console warnings about header spoofing.

alex: Sounds good. Can someone open a short RFC and include the metric names + sampling config?

maria: I'll draft RFC and create a canary runbook.

tj: I'll add the metric counters to the infra chart and the sampling hook in the proxy.

sam: I'll coordinate with support to prepare canned responses for customers if they see attribution shifts.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: identity-resolution/v2 feature branch -> staging (build 4521). :rocket:
